usage: agentware metrics [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--session SESSION]
                         [--feature FEATURE] [--since SINCE] [--prices PRICES]
                         [--context-window CONTEXT_WINDOW] [--retrieval]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --session SESSION     restrict to a single session id
  --feature FEATURE     sessions whose transcript references the feature
  --since SINCE         only sessions starting on/after YYYY-MM-DD
  --prices PRICES       path to a JSON price table ($ per 1M tokens, keyed by
                        model-id substring) overriding the built-in default
                        cost rates
  --context-window CONTEXT_WINDOW
                        model context-window size (tokens) the context-tax
                        truncation-risk is measured against (default 200000)
  --retrieval           report per-session RETRIEVAL utilization over
                        live.jsonl (recall invoked, returned ids, read-
                        through, corpus coverage) instead of execution-cost
                        metrics
